description: Determination as to whether prior approval is required for part change of use from commercial space (Class E) at lower ground level to one residential flat (Class C3).
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - This notice indicates that the proposed development would comply with conditions MA.2 of Schedule 2 Part 3 Class MA of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (as amended) ("the GPDO"). 
It is a requirement of condition MA.2(5) of the GPDO that the development must be completed within a period of 3 years starting with the prior approval date. 
It is a requirement of condition MA.2(6) of the GPDO that a building which has changed use under Class MA is to be used as a dwellinghouse within the meaning of Class C3 of the Schedule to the Use Classes Order and for no other purpose, except to the extent that the other purpose is ancillary to the primary use as such a dwellinghouse.
It is a requirement of paragraph W(12) of the GPDO that the development is carried out in accordance with the details provided in the application unless the developer and the local planning authority agree in writing.

Condition : 2 - Prior to the commencement of the use hereby permitted, details of a scheme for the sound insulation of the separating wall between the adjacent (lower) ground floor commercial uses and the proposed residential unit shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, and the approved scheme shall be implemented prior to the first occupation of the dwelling and shall be retained thereafter.
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of residential occupiers, in accordance with Council policy LP2 and LP14 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 3 - INFORMATIVE: You are advised that this application is made under Class MA, Part 3, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country (General Permitted Development) (Amendment) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) only and does not override any such planning conditions or associated legal agreements that relate to the site, buildings or uses.
